newsitem.title: CHINA: Works of Mao, Deng make Beijing jail model prison.
newsitem.headline: Works of Mao, Deng make Beijing jail model prison.

text.p: A daily dose of the writings of the late chairman Mao Zedong and paramount leader Deng Xiaoping have helped a Beijing jail become a model institute of detention.
Authorities awarded Beijing Prison the accolade of "modern civilised prison" last November for its low rate of criminal activity and violence among inmates, the People's Daily said on Tuesday.

"Every morning after work... prison officials at the middle level and above study the relevant works of Mao Zedong and Deng Xiaoping, combining direct indoctrination with discussion," the official newspaper said.
The prison, which housed male inmates serving sentences of 10 years or less, had not reported any fires, explosions, riots or abnormal deaths among inmates in recent years, it said.
No prisoners had escaped in the last three years and the crime rate within the prison was below 0.6 percent, it said without elaborating.

China's propaganda machine has been trumpeting the country's model prisons in recent weeks, boasting of their comfortable "hotel-like" environment and salaries higher than the minimum wage in the Chinese capital.
